notes.title: WonderLang 1.10 is here!
notes.content:
This major update brings big improvements to performance, accessibility, and the overall learning experience. Here’s what’s new:

1. Smoother performance across the board
The game now runs more smoothly, with higher FPS even on slower machines.

2. Full Steam Deck support
WonderLang now plays flawlessly on Steam Deck, with an official control layout optimized for handheld play.

3. Smarter auto-saving
The game now automatically saves after each dialogue, making it easier to stop and resume anytime — no progress lost!

4. Slowed-down speech options + improved listening support

All NPC lines are now slightly slower by default, to improve clarity.

You can also replay lines at a slower speed during dialogues, exercises, and reviews — perfect for learners.

5. In-game notepad for taking and reviewing notes
Take notes during dialogues or from the pause menu (check your documents for the notepad item).
You can also review your notes during certain dialogue exercises.

6. Mouse playability significantly improved

Better pathfinding and smoother movement

Events/NPCs no longer trigger by accident

Transitions between areas now work reliably with mouse only

7. Type accented characters with your physical keyboard
Special characters (é, ç, ñ, etc.) are now assigned to number keys on your physical keyboard — no need to open the visual keyboard if you don’t want to.

8. Now compatible with Intel-based Macs
WonderLang now runs on both Apple Silicon and Intel-based Macs.

9. Improved character portraits
Some portraits were updated to create a more cohesive and consistent art style.

10. Added missing voice lines
A few missing audio lines have now been added.

11. Better mini-game experience
Several mini-games and test sections were tweaked for smoother, more intuitive gameplay.

12. Bug fixes and visual polish
Various minor bugs and display issues have been cleaned up.

📬 Got feedback?
If you spot a bug or have suggestions for improvement, don’t hesitate to reach out: contact@wonderlang.net
We love hearing from players and learners!

notes.title: Major WonderLang Update – Steam Deck Support & New Learning Modes!
notes.content:
Hey WonderLang players! We’ve been working hard to bring you a major update that improves usability, customization, and overall experience. Here’s what’s new:

🎮 Full Steam Deck Compatibility!
WonderLang is now fully Steam Deck compatible! We’ve added a virtual keyboard that allows you to type directly on the touchscreen, making the game much smoother to play on Steam Deck. No more workarounds—just seamless gameplay!

📚 Choose Your Learning Level!
We know every learner is different, so we’ve introduced three new modes to tailor the experience to your skill level:

🟢 Beginner Mode – Perfect for complete beginners! Includes extra review challenges to reinforce learning.
🔵 A1 Level – For learners aiming for A1 or those who have recently reached it. Skips simpler challenges and review sections, allowing faster progress.
🟠 A2 Level – For learners aiming for A2+ who want to focus on advanced content. Removes review challenges and makes earlier sections optional.
✨ You can switch between these modes anytime in the settings! If you already started playing, the option will be set to beginner by default.

🔧 Bug Fixes & Translation Improvements
We’ve also made various small bug fixes and translation improvements to enhance your experience.

Thank you for playing WonderLang! Your feedback keeps us improving the game. If you have any suggestions, let us know in the community discussions.

Happy learning! 🚀📖
